mcqs.question: Two line segments are drawn: segment AB and segment CD. Which statement correctly compares their endpoints?

options.A: A and B are the endpoints of segment AB, while C and D are the endpoints of segment CD.
options.B: A and C are the endpoints of segment AB, while B and D are the endpoints of segment CD.
options.C: A and D are the endpoints of segment AB, while B and C are the endpoints of segment CD.
options.D: All four points A, B, C, D are interior points of both segments.

mcqs.answer: A and B are the endpoints of segment AB, while C and D are the endpoints of segment CD.
mcqs.explanation: An endpoint of a line segment is a point where the segment terminates. In segment AB the endpoints are exactly A and B; in segment CD they are C and D. The other options mix up the points or incorrectly label interior points as endpoints.

mcqs.learning_point: Understand the part joining two points
mcqs.question: Which of the following best describes a line segment?

options.A: An infinite set of points extending in both directions.
options.B: A part of a line that connects two points and includes only the points between them.
options.C: A curved path joining two points.
options.D: A single point that lies between two other points.

mcqs.answer: A part of a line that connects two points and includes only the points between them.
mcqs.explanation: A line segment is the portion of a straight line that joins two distinct points and contains every point on the line that lies between those two endpoints. Option A describes a line, C describes a curve, and D describes a point, none of which are correct definitions of a line segment.

mcqs.learning_point: Measure the length of a segment
mcqs.question: What is the length of segment PQ if P has coordinates (2, 3) and Q has coordinates (6, 7)?
mcqs.explanation: The distance formula gives the length of a segment between (x₁,y₁) and (x₂,y₂) as √[(x₂‑x₁)²+(y₂‑y₁)²]. Here, √[(6‑2)²+(7‑3)²] = √[4²+4²] = √[16+16] = √32 = 4√2. Hence option C is correct.

mcqs.question: Segment AB is 5 cm long and segment CD is 8 cm long. Which statement is true?

options.B: AB and CD are of equal length.

mcqs.explanation: Since 8 cm > 5 cm, segment CD is longer than segment AB. Options A and B contradict the given lengths, and D is unrelated.

mcqs.question: Which description correctly distinguishes an endpoint of a line segment from an interior point?

options.A: An endpoint lies on the segment, while an interior point lies outside the segment.
options.B: An endpoint is one of the two extreme points of the segment; an interior point lies between the endpoints.
options.C: Both endpoint and interior point are the same; they are just different names.
options.D: An interior point is at the very end of the segment, while an endpoint is in the middle.

mcqs.answer: An endpoint is one of the two extreme points of the segment; an interior point lies between the endpoints.
mcqs.explanation: A line segment has exactly two endpoints – the points where it starts and ends. Any other point on the segment that is not an endpoint is called an interior point. Options A, C, and D misstate the relationship.

mcqs.learning_point: Understand the part joining two points
mcqs.question: A gardener wants to install a straight fence between two garden posts labeled P and Q. Which geometric object best represents the fence?

options.B: A ray starting at P and passing through Q
options.C: A line segment with endpoints P and Q
options.D: A circle centered at P passing through Q

mcqs.answer: A line segment with endpoints P and Q
mcqs.explanation: The fence has a definite start (post P) and end (post Q) and includes all points between them, which matches the definition of a line segment. A line would extend infinitely, a ray would continue beyond Q, and a circle is a completely different shape.

mcqs.learning_point: Measure the length of a segment
mcqs.question: On a grid paper, point A is at (1, 2) and point B is at (4, 6). What is the length of segment AB?
mcqs.explanation: Using the distance formula: √[(4‑1)²+(6‑2)²] = √[3²+4²] = √[9+16] = √25 = 5. Option B correctly states the length. Option C writes the same value but does not simplify; however the answer must match the option text, and B is the simplified correct choice.

mcqs.question: In a classroom, three line segments are drawn on the board: XY = 7 cm, YZ = 9 cm, and XZ = 12 cm. Which statement is true?

options.B: YZ is shorter than both XY and XZ.
options.D: All three segments have the same length.

mcqs.explanation: Comparing the given lengths, 12 cm (XZ) > 9 cm (YZ) > 7 cm (XY). Therefore XZ is the longest. Options A, B, and D are incorrect based on the numeric comparison.
